architecture.summary: UI-01 changes presentation inside the existing Web owner: pass the existing trusted MemberOverview organizationName to private layout chrome, escape it, label ordinary page links, use a 32px shared title and full-width Members, and focus main after the skip link. Audit keeps its form, script, Save/Test, context and current lookups. Style/script CSP hashes still derive actual bytes; admission, session, permissions, mutations, recovery, seat counts and approved help remain unchanged. No new production component, import edge, public module/declaration, provider call, store, deployment boundary or dependency. All registry drawings remain unchanged because the existing member-read and Web responsibility descriptions still apply. The test-gate document updates the browser group inventory; commands, selection, required checks and decision authority do not change.
